items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: Hogan played drums. Okay. And that was with the Lloyd Price band?

ctx.x: And the last two I know were from New Orleans. Who else was from New Orleans in that band? Lester never played with the band. Excuse me? Lester didn't play with that band.
Oh no, you mentioned Hogan and Bill Jones. Yeah. Bill Jones played guitar and Hogan played drums. Okay. And that was with the Lloyd Price band?
Yeah. Okay. My point was Bill Jones and Hogan are recognized as being from New Orleans, but the other people,
